Data:B.nyctodromy.json.label: Topic: Nyctodromy
Data:B.nyctodromy.json.desc: A text on the ways and byways of the transmundane.

Data:B.preservation.json.label: Topic: Preservation
Data:B.preservation.json.desc: A text on healing and restoration.

Data:B.skolekosophy.json.label: Topic: Skolekosophy
Data:B.skolekosophy.json.desc: A text on matters that there shouldn't really be texts on.

Data:Bag.tricks.json.Label: Bag of Tricks
Data:Bag.tricks.json.Desc: 'Useful': a treacherously subjective term. Does this contain anything useful?

Data:Bake.mushroom.potato.json.Label: Mushroom & Potato Bake
Data:Bake.mushroom.potato.json.Desc: Collers tried out a variation on this as Cucurbit prison fare. It was tasty; but allegedly also he was interested in the connection between the modulation of the taste of mushrooms, and the suppression of the Crowned Growth.

Data:Basket.laundry.json.Label: Basket of Dirty Laundry
Data:Basket.laundry.json.Desc: Once washed, it'll be suitable again.

xexts.scrutiny: No Librarian washes their own laundry. Perhaps I can find help in the village.
I can use this to ensure a good night's sleep. [If you have no Beverages available to cure Maladies, this will do - though it won't provide any additional Power Aspects.]

Data:Basket.towels.damp.json.Label: Basket of Damp Towels
Data:Basket.towels.damp.json.Desc: A bath-time luxury (but soggy from use, now.)

xexts.scrutiny: They'll be dry the next day.
If I go swimming, I should take these. They'll be dry the next day.

Data:Batter.json.Label: Batter
Data:Batter.json.Desc: [Add Dripping for something horrifyingly tasty; or use with a Knife and Onions.]

xexts.scrutiny: If food entered battle, this would be its armour.

Data:Beast.json.label: Beast
Data:Beast.json.desc: When it moves, and it's not the wind, and it's not a person.

Data:Bed.guest.camp.hint.json.label: Moving In
Data:Bed.guest.camp.hint.json.startdescription: This isn't my bed... yet. [Use a Soul card to move your belongings in and make this your bed.]

Data:Bed.guest.camp.json.label: Camp
Data:Bed.guest.camp.json.startdescription: I'll make this my lodgings for the time being. [Move your belongings into this room; you can then use this bed to rest Soul cards and recover Maladies.]
Data:Bed.guest.camp.json.desc: This is a safe place for me now... to the extent that dreams are safe.

Data:Bed.guest.camp.malady.hint.json.label: Moving In
Data:Bed.guest.camp.malady.hint.json.startdescription: This isn't my bed... yet. [Use a Soul card to move your belongings in and make this your bed.]

Data:Bed.guest.campedelsewhere.hint.json.label: Another Room?
Data:Bed.guest.campedelsewhere.hint.json.startdescription: I'm sleeping somewhere else at the moment. [Use a Soul card in your current bed to decamp; and then come back here to move in.]

Data:Bed.guest.visitor.json.label: Camp
Data:Bed.guest.visitor.json.startdescription: [Visitors will stay in a suitable bed for a little longer - in case you think you might be close to finding a suitable book.]

Data:Bed.rest.ability.restable.hint.json.label: Rest?
Data:Bed.rest.ability.restable.hint.json.startdescription: I could settle in for a nap with a cup of something warming, or a glass of something soothing. [Add something Restorative, like a Beverage or fresh linen, to restore your Soul card without waiting overnight.]

Data:Bed.rest.crafting.blocker.json.label: Crafting in Bed is Not Safe
Data:Bed.rest.crafting.blocker.json.startdescription: If I want to make something, I'll need to get out of bed - but if I want to cure a Malady, I can use Skills and Memories with something Restorative, like fresh linen or a Beverage.

Data:Bed.rest.decamp.json.label: Decamp
Data:Bed.rest.decamp.json.startdescription: Hush House is a mansion of many rooms. I'll move to a different one. [Or add other cards if you'd like to try something else.]
Data:Bed.rest.decamp.json.desc: Gathered my belongings, refreshed the sheets for any guests I might have. Ready to move on.

Data:Bed.rest.json.label: Rest
Data:Bed.rest.json.startdescription: A quick nap in a warm bed with something comforting to drink, while the winds chase the clouds and the clouds chase the sun. [Restore a fatigued Soul card.]
Data:Bed.rest.json.desc: I deserved a little quiet time.

Data:Bed.rest.malady.curable.hint.json.label: Cure a Malady?
Data:Bed.rest.malady.curable.hint.json.startdescription: I could cure this Malady with bed rest, something suitable to drink, and enough of the relevant Aspect. [Check the Malady card for details.]

Data:Bed.rest.malady.forge.json.label: Cure my Malady
Data:Bed.rest.malady.forge.json.startdescription: I need warmth and brightness as I rest. [You've supplied enough Forge.]

Data:Bed.rest.malady.grail.json.label: Cure my Malady
Data:Bed.rest.malady.grail.json.startdescription: Strong sensation will bring my wandering spirit home.

Data:Bed.rest.memory.hint.json.label: Dream on a Memory?
Data:Bed.rest.memory.hint.json.startdescription: Night has not yet fallen. But once it has, I can rest - and perhaps dream on the day's doings. [Dreaming on a Memory will preserve it past Dawn, allowing you to keep it until the following day. Add a Memory once the sun has set.]

Data:Bed.rest.memory.json.label: Dream on a Memory
Data:Bed.rest.memory.json.startdescription: Now that night has fallen, I can rest - and perhaps dream on the day's doings. [Dreaming on a Memory will preserve it past Dawn, allowing you to keep it until the following day.]
Data:Bed.rest.memory.json.desc: I've carried a Memory like a flambeau safe through the mazes of night. [This will complete once dawn has come.]
